findings.message: Carried over from review-7-qa (r4) and review-9-qa (r5), unchanged by this revision: storm-engine (line 341) places the backup wheel 'on the wall' in the engine room, but the bring-dex-along branch at storm-engine-together (lines 353-357) has Jun and Dex 'climbed the steps together... At the top, the dust storm filled the window in a wall of white' before reaching the same threshold passage, implying a different location for the same wheel. Not blocking.

Carried over from review-3-qa/review-7-qa/review-9-qa, unchanged by this revision: lines 128-143. Oru states the pod order ('First the latch. Then the switch. Last the hatch', line 134) immediately before the three-way choice, so picking switch-first or hatch-first (lines 140, 142) requires no real inference. The not-yet/not-yet-why loop that follows a wrong guess is a reasonable mitigation and is now a genuine branch (see below), but the original three-way choice is still not a real inference test.

Carried over from review-3-qa/review-7-qa/review-9-qa, unchanged by this revision: captain-wakes (lines 186-188) has the Captain say calls to far decks 'cannot get through' and the comm panel stays dark, but storm-bridge (line 204, Dex's voice on the inside speaker), storm-engine (line 340, Captain Holm's voice reaching the engine room) and ending-1 (line 439, Captain Holm and Dex cheering over the speaker) all have voice communication working shortly after. Not blocking, but the comms logic is inconsistent across routes.

Carried over from review-3-qa/review-7-qa/review-9-qa, unchanged by this revision: oru-log (line 85) says the dust 'bends the sensors' so 'maps may not match what is real,' yet storm-bridge's study-ghosts branch (lines 206-210) has the correct clear lane visible directly on the bent screen, while dex-chart (lines 320-331) praises the hand-drawn paper chart specifically because it does not match the (same) bent screen. The two routes make opposite claims about whether the live screen can be trusted. Not blocking, but worth reconciling.

New in this revision: dex-lamp-watch (lines 251-254) and dex-tools-sort (lines 285-290) both add 'Across the room, a paper chart hung on the wall' and let Jun 'Glance at the wall chart' (choices go-to-chart / go-to-chart-tools, lines 258-264 and 295-301) before Dex has even finished the repair. Both routes then pass through dex-fixed and on to dex-chart (lines 320-326), where the same chart is narrated as a first-time discovery ('Dex tapped a paper chart pinned to the wall... Paper does not lie, he said. I drew this from the old logs.'). On these two routes the reader is told they already glanced at the chart, then the story re-introduces it as new. Mechanically harmless (dust-map is granted idempotently and the clue notebook shows its description regardless of route, per src/ui/Reader.tsx lines 229-240), but a continuity nit worth a line of differentiation in dex-chart for readers arriving via these two choices.

notes: Verified fix for review-9-qa major finding 1 (not-yet-why): after-not-yet-why (line 171) now carries effects.addClues=[dust-map] and skip-explanation (line 177) carries no effects; both still target captain-wakes. The two choices are now genuinely different in player state, matching the item/clue-gated idiom already used at captain-wakes, dex-fixed, storm-bridge and dex-chart.

Verified fix for review-9-qa major finding 2 (storm-engine-together): double-check-sensors (line 363) now carries effects.addClues=[dust-map]; to-threshold-together (line 361) carries no effects. Both still target threshold. Genuinely different now.

Verified fix for review-9-qa major finding 3 (dex-lamp-watch / dex-tools-sort silent bypass of dex-fixed): go-to-chart (dex-lamp-watch, line 261) and go-to-chart-tools (dex-tools-sort, line 298) were retargeted from dex-chart to dex-fixed. Confirmed in reports/graph.r6.json edges: both choices now show 'to': 'dex-fixed'. Re-traced the predecessor's flagged route exactly: wake -> ask-log -> oru-log -> ask-oru-more -> oru-log-crew -> hurry-to-engine-crew -> engine -> pass-tools -> dex-tools -> sort-tools -> dex-tools-sort -> go-to-chart-tools -> dex-fixed -> take-bench-pack (gains tool-pack) -> dex-chart -> copy-lane/skip-lane -> storm-engine -> take-backup-wheel or bring-dex-along -> threshold -> thin-lane (unlocked, dust-map already held from oru-log and/or go-to-chart-tools) -> climax-lane -> use-clicker (unlocked, tool-pack held) -> ending-1 (clear-road / clicker-triumph). The route is fully reachable and dex-fixed's explicit, informed tool-pack offer (take-bench-pack / skip-bench-pack, lines 315-316) can no longer be silently skipped on any engine-room route: every edge from dex-lamp, dex-lamp-watch, dex-tools and dex-tools-sort now leads to dex-fixed before dex-chart or storm-engine (confirmed against every edge in reports/graph.r6.json).

Checked the dust-map clue reuse across the four fixed choices (not-yet-why/after-not-yet-why, storm-engine-together/double-check-sensors, dex-lamp-watch/go-to-chart, dex-tools-sort/go-to-chart-tools) plus the three pre-existing grant points (oru-log, storm-bridge/study-ghosts, dex-chart/copy-lane): addClues is idempotent (src/engine/story-engine.ts line 21, uniq over the clue array), so re-granting the same clue on an already-holding state is a harmless no-op, not a bug. dust-map is required only at threshold's thin-lane choice, which is one of three choices there (shield-sensors and cut-engines remain open with no clue requirement), so there is no soft-lock: a reader who never collects dust-map simply cannot take the thin-lane route to ending-1 but can still reach every other ending. No route requires dust-map to make forward progress past a passage with no alternative.

Traced at least one route to all five endings from wake: ending-1/clear-road via the tool-pack + dust-map route above; ending-2/steady-hands via climax-lane -> steer-by-eye; ending-3/sensor-mast via threshold -> shield-sensors -> climax-team -> send-dex; ending-4/many-hands via climax-team -> wake-watch; ending-5/drifting-quiet via threshold -> cut-engines. All five match reports/graph.r6.json reachableEndings (clear-road, drifting-quiet, many-hands, sensor-mast, steady-hands) and stateSearchComplete: true.

Content integrity: no sexual content, no violence or gore, no self-harm or suicide references, no specific-religion references; no crew member dies on the page and the colony-ship/dust-storm premise, item (tool-pack) and clue (dust-map) stay consistent with brief.json's continuity facts and avoid-list across every passage read. lockedHint text at threshold/thin-lane and climax-lane/use-clicker accurately and fairly describes where the gated item/clue can be found (locker, Captain's rack, Dex's bench; a log or a chart) without naming them outright.
